reason: Provides configurable stream rules that steer agent behavior and optionally deny the first matching tool call, making agent orchestration its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过匹配工具调用并注入自定义规则来引导智能体行为，也可首次拒绝匹配的工具调用。
summaries.en: Steers agent behavior with user-defined rules that match tool calls and can optionally deny the first matching call.

capabilities: Matches agent tool calls and serialized arguments against user-defined JavaScript rules
Injects steering notices into the agent after matching tool calls
Can deny the first matching tool call when a rule enables rejection
Loads rules from a configurable local directory
